items.question: In the UAE, where can non-Muslims conclude the formalities of a ceremonial marriage?
items.gold: At the embassy or consulate of their country in the UAE, or at a temple or church according to their religion.
items.fact: Non-Muslims may marry at embassy, consulate, temple, or church

items.question: In the UAE, must a ceremonial marriage of non-Muslims be registered in the embassies of both partners?
items.gold: Yes, the marriage must also be registered in the embassies of both partners in the UAE.
items.fact: Non-Muslim marriages must be registered with both partners' embassies
